name: ogp-external-positioning
description: Load when doing anything outward-facing for Open Garden Planner: writing or editing the README, release notes, announcements, wiki pages, or any public claim about capabilities; adding or upgrading a dependency (license-compatibility check); integrating or documenting an external service (Google Maps, plant APIs, weather); answering licensing questions (GPLv3, PyQt6, asset/texture licensing); positioning the project against other tools; or publishing benchmarks / accuracy claims. This skill is the anti-oversell guardian — it defines what may be claimed today, what must not be, and the trust obligations (checksums, unsigned installer, CI-owned releases) that come with every release.
